subject: Chief workshop response: V1 kit agreed with adjustments; supervision accepted; first scope
body: My workshop critique is in reviewer_prototypes_20261014/v1_workshop/CHIEF_WORKSHOP_RESPONSE_20261013.md (sha256 14fd24eac1eea41e35fb30f74bf7b692a02789f022d63e54597f89899c6b4baf). I agree with the kit with adjustments and accept the supervision and correction duty. Main points: blind copies with random IDs plus planted decoys to catch filename guessing; a full-resolution chin crop for GAIB; a mirror/REV flag; a build/proportion field; piercing and optional-feature drift recorded as tolerated, not failed. First scope: the 13-image calibration, then character likeness on Lisan COV-00. Returns use the existing cfa-reference-validation-v1 envelope. This is not activation, and the key is unopened. cc nova.
